assumptions: Historical time starts at first observation, not origination. Entry-known 00-02 loans only; no exposure-eligibility filtering of risk denominators.
Default proxy and combined payoff/maturity follow Phase2F. No pure-prepayment claim.

Unknown/ambiguous/unsupported states censor before their interval; reporting gaps censor after the previous valid month; other exits and observation ends censor at the interval end. Within-month ordering is a project convention.

Cumulative incidence uses joint survival and both competing hazards. Censoring removes observations from later risk sets, not from probability mass. Noninformative censoring is an unverified identification assumption.
Constant illustrative hazards pool events over observed risk-months in the first 12 months; they are not the age-varying historical curve and are not validated out-of-time predictions.

The $100,000 loan, 4% coupon, 120-month remaining term, 20%/35% LGDs and adverse hazard multipliers are judgmental demonstration inputs, not measured cohort economics or a macro-calibrated stress scenario.
Conditional exposure follows fixed-rate scheduled amortization. Defaults and proxy payoffs occur on opening balances before payment. Surviving probability matures at the final scheduled payment.

Expected loss is undiscounted marginal default probability times conditional opening exposure times assumed LGD; survival is applied once. Assumed recoveries equal defaulted balance times one minus LGD, with no recovery timing model.
The loss example is synthetic and does not impute masked real balances. Full-cohort loss estimation, verified maturity, severity estimation, revisions, and predictive validation remain open.
